contract: Historical response body and world_step remain unchanged. Exact-context checkpoint credit_step is independent, mandatory, and nondecreasing. Ordered replies retain their sequence, epoch, and admission tick.
regressions: Raw serialized snapshot body remains byte-identical after attaching credit.
Ordered replies on two connections receive their own checkpoint credit without capping earlier acknowledgments to a later historical snapshot.
A historical snapshot validates with current credit; regressing or missing credit is refused.
Existing delayed TLS, storage-stall, reconciliation, durability, and replication checks pass.
limitations: Host and clients require coordinated upgrade to protocol version 28.
Crowded delayed performance acceptance remains unproven for this revision.
